prose: Business Insider reports that Anthropic's internal AI usage, priced at retail rates, now exceeds what the company pays its employees. If the internal figure is real, it is a striking marker of where frontier-lab cost structure is heading: the models themselves becoming a bigger line item than the people who build them.
highlights: BI: Anthropic's internal AI use at retail prices exceeds total employee pay
An indicator of frontier-lab cost structure shifting from payroll to compute
